title: Liquid-Cooled NVIDIA Servers at the ASRock Rack OCP 2026 Booth
gist: At OCP Global Summit 2026, ASRock Rack showed a broad liquid-cooled NVIDIA lineup, including its XGMRACK-VR/NVL72 Vera Rubin NVL72 rack (72 Rubin GPUs, 20.7TB HBM4, four 110kW power shelves) and a fanless 2U HGX Rubin NVL8 server, underscoring direct-to-chip liquid cooling as the default for Rubin-generation systems.

insights.claim: ASRock Rack's XGMRACK-VR/NVL72 is a 48RU NVIDIA MGX rack with a 5000A busbar and liquid manifold, holding 18 Vera Rubin compute trays and nine NVLink 6 switch trays for 36 Vera CPUs and 72 Rubin GPUs.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: ODMs beyond the largest OEMs are shipping full Vera Rubin NVL72 racks.
insights.locator: The XGMRACK-VR/NVL72 is ASRock Rack’s version

insights.claim: NVIDIA rates the Vera Rubin NVL72 rack at 3,600 PFLOPS NVFP4 sparse inference and 2,520 PFLOPS NVFP4 dense training, with 20.7TB of HBM4 total and 288GB per Rubin GPU.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Each rack consumes ~20.7TB of HBM4, a direct driver of HBM demand.
insights.quote: It has 20.7TB of HBM4, and each Rubin GPU gets 288GB.
insights.locator: NVIDIA lists the full rack at 3,600 PFLOPS

insights.claim: The Vera Rubin NVL72 rack is powered by four 3RU power shelves rated at 110kW each, each using six 18.3kW PSUs plus bulk capacitors.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Implies up to ~440kW of power-shelf capacity per rack, raising datacenter power and cooling requirements.
insights.locator: NVIDIA lists the full rack at 3,600 PFLOPS

insights.claim: Each 1U compute tray holds two Vera Rubin Superchips (each two Rubin GPUs plus one Vera CPU over NVLink-C2C), with eight 800Gbps OSFP ports from ConnectX-9 SuperNICs and two 400Gbps ports from a BlueField-4 DPU.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: High per-tray networking attach supports NVIDIA's networking revenue.
insights.locator: Each compute tray is a 1U NVIDIA MGX design

insights.claim: Liquid cooling was a major theme at ASRock Rack's OCP booth, with direct-to-chip liquid cooling used on its rack-scale system and HGX servers, including an 8x RTX PRO 6000 PCIe server.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Direct-to-chip cooling is spreading from flagship racks to more mainstream GPU servers.
insights.quote: A big theme was liquid cooling.
insights.locator: A big theme was liquid cooling.

insights.claim: Fully liquid-cooled trays help lower total rack power consumption, an approach NVIDIA has advanced with partners for several generations.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Supports demand for liquid-cooling suppliers (CDUs, manifolds, cold plates).

insights.claim: ASRock Rack offers in-rack, in-row, rear-door heat exchanger (RDHx) or liquid-to-air sidecar CDU options for the NVL72 rack.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Liquid-to-air sidecars let operators deploy liquid racks in facilities lacking facility water.
insights.locator: NVIDIA lists the full rack at 3,600 PFLOPS

insights.claim: ASRock Rack's 2U16X-GNR2/DLC RUBIN fits an HGX Rubin NVL8 board with eight Rubin GPUs into a fanless, fully liquid-cooled 2U chassis powered over a 54V DC busbar.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Liquid cooling enables much higher 8-GPU server density than air-cooled designs.
insights.quote: It is fully liquid-cooled, covering the E1.S drives, CPUs, and GPUs, with no fans.

insights.claim: The 2U HGX Rubin server uses a dual-socket Intel Xeon 6 host, and STH expects most buyers to choose the Xeon 6700P series given the cost of the rest of the system.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Intel retains host-CPU sockets in HGX-style systems even as NVIDIA pushes Vera CPUs.
insights.locator: The host is a dual-socket Intel Xeon 6

insights.claim: NVIDIA quotes 400 PFLOPS of NVFP4 sparse compute for HGX Rubin NVL8.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Benchmark figure for the 8-GPU Rubin building block.

insights.claim: The HGX 8-GPU platform changed GPU orientation in the tray this generation, enabling use in high-density liquid-cooled racks.
insights.speaker: Patrick Kennedy
insights.so_what: Form-factor redesign signals HGX is being re-architected around liquid cooling.
insights.locator: The HGX 8-GPU platform underwent major changes
